description.value:
This light blue amulet increases your defenses.

Neck Slot: Common

Enhancement Bonus: Fortitude, Reflex, and Will

This pearl grows warm to the touch each time you attack, ready to overcome your enemies' best attempts to thwart you.

Wondrous Item: Uncommon

Power ✦ Daily (Free Action)

Trigger: You miss all targets with an encounter attack power of level 3 or lower.

Level 17: You can use the pearl with an encounter attack power of level 13 or lower.

Level 27: You can use the pearl with an encounter attack power of level 23 or lower.

Effect: You do not expend the use of the power.

This gem-encrusted wheel bolsters its host astral ship and enhances the magical powers of the pilot.

Wondrous Item: Rare

Properties:

  • The helm's other properties work only aboard an astral vessel on which the helm is installed as a steering wheel.
  • The helm increases its vessel's speed by 2 and its defenses to the pilot's level + 10.
  • The pilot must take 10 minutes to attune to the helm, which can have only one attuned pilot at a given time.
  • While touching the helm with at least one free hand, the pilot can choose 1 square on or adjacent to the helm's vessel to use as the origin square for the pilot's area, close, or ranged implement attack powers.
  • While touching the helm with at least one free hand, if the pilot activates a nondamaging aura, the helm's vessel is considered to be the source from which the aura emanates. The helm's vessel can emanate only one such aura at a time. The vessel itself, including its whole area, is unaffected by the aura.

Power ✦ Daily (Standard Action)

Effect: The helm's vessel and all aboard it become invisible for 5 minutes or until it or someone aboard it attacks. Any creature that leaves the invisible vessel's area immediately ends the invisibility effect on itself.

This chiffon headwrap is stitched with eye-shaped patterns, which heighten your senses.

Head Slot: Common

Property:

You gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks.

Level 11: Gain a +3 item bonus to Perception checks

Level 21: Gain a +5 item bonus to Perception checks

These heavy bracers are each mounted with a long dragonlike skull.

Arms Slot: Uncommon

Power ✦ Daily (Minor Action)

The next successful attack you make before the end of your next turn deals an extra 1d10 damage.

Level 17: 2d10 damage.

Level 27: 3d10 damage.

This vermilion liquid invigorates you, at least temporarily.

Consumable: Potion - Common

Power ✦ Consumable (Minor Action)

Drink this potion and spend a healing surge. You do not gain hit points as normal. Instead, gain 15 temporary hit points.

Level 19: gain 25 temporary hit points.

Level 29: gain 35 temporary hit points.

When shattered, this flask fills an area with alchemical flame.

Make an attack: Area burst 1 within 10; +9 vs. Reflex; on a hit, deal 2d6 fire damage; on a miss, deal half damage.

Alchemical Item

Power ✦ Consumable (Standard Action)

Make an attack: Area burst 1 within 10; +9 vs. Reflex; on a hit, deal 2d6 fire damage; on a miss, deal half damage.

A sheen of wet blood coats this wooden shield, protecting you when you are seriously injured.

Arms Slot: Any Shield - Uncommon

Power ✦ Daily (Minor Action)

Use this power while you are bloodied. Gain resist 2 to all damage until the end of the encounter, or until you are no longer bloodied, whichever comes first.

Level 19: Resist 5 to all damage.

Level 29: Resist 8 to all damage.

From between the white scales of this armor, a chilling mist flows from your body to your target as you strike.

Armor: Scale

Enhancement Bonus: AC

Property:

Resist 10 cold.

Level 23: Resist 15

Level 28: Resist 20

Power ✦ Daily (Free Action)

Use this power when you hit a target with a melee attack. The target and its adjacent allies take additional cold damage equal to 1d4 + your Constitution modifier.

Level 23: 2d4 + Constitution modifier.

Level 28: 3d4 + Constitution modifier.

When bonded to you, this spellblade returns to your hand faster and from farther distances.

Weapon: Heavy blade or light blade

Enhancement Bonus: Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls

Critical: +5d6 critical damage, or +5d8 when used as an implement for an arcane power

Property:

This weapon can be used as a heavy thrown weapon with a range of 5/10. If you have the Swordbond class feature, you can call this weapon to your hand from up to a mile away.

This pale white stone emits feelings of calm and goodwill, making your enemies willing to attack those you choose.

Implement: Orb

Enhancement Bonus: Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls

Critical: +3d6 psychic critical damage

Property:

You gain an item bonus to Diplomacy checks equal to the orb's enhancement bonus.

Power ✦ Daily (Free Action)

Trigger: You hit an enemy with an attack using this orb.

Effect: The enemy makes a melee basic attack as a free action against a creature of your choice that is adjacent to it.

Augment 2: The enemy gains a power bonus to the attack roll equal to your Wisdom modifier.

This supple cloak feels cool to the touch, and can turn back attacks with the strength of the strongest armor.

Neck Slot: Uncommon

Enhancement Bonus: Fortitude, Reflex, and Will

Power ✦ Daily (Minor Action)

You gain resist 5 to all damage until the start of your next turn.

Augment 1: Increase the resistance by 5.

Level 13: Resist 10 to all damage.

Level 18: Resist 10 to all damage.

Level 23: Resist 15 to all damage.

Level 28: Resist 15 to all damage.

Ioun's eye marks this bright yellow arrow.

Ammunition: Uncommon

Enhancement Bonus: attack rolls and damage rolls

Property:

When you hit an enemy using this ammunition, that enemy doesn't benefit from invisibility until the end of your next turn.

Asmodeus invests you with the authority he uses to rule the Nine Hells.

Alternative Reward: Divine Boon - Rare

Power ✦ Encounter (Minor Action)

Attack: Ranged 10 (one creature); the boon's level + 5 vs. Will

Hit: The target is subject to your dread authority (save ends). Until this effect ends, you can slide the target 1 square as a free action at the start of each of its turns.

Level 13: Slide the target up to 2 squares.

Level 23: Slide the target up to 3 squares.

Power ✦ Daily (Minor Action)

Effect: Ranged 10 (the creature subject to your dread authority). The target chooses either to fall prone or to take 5 fire damage.

Level 13: 10 fire damage.

Level 23: 15 fire damage.

This black leather bridle decorated with a flame motif grants healing power and can transform your mount into a fiery steed.

Mount: Uncommon

Property:

When you spend a healing surge to regain hit points, your mount also regains hit points as if it had spent a healing surge.

Power ✦ Daily (Minor Action)

Your mount transforms into a creature of wind and flame. The mount gains resist 20 fire. Any creature other than you that starts its turn on or adjacent to the mount takes 2d6 fire damage. Your mount retains this form until the end of the encounter, until you end the power as a free action, or until you are no longer mounted on it.

This jeweled collar or harness identifies your familiar as belonging to you and extends your protection to it.

Familiar Slot: Common

Enhancement Bonus: to all defenses

Property:

Your familiar gains a +1 item bonus to all defenses.

Level 13: +2 item bonus to all defenses.

Level 23: +3 item bonus to all defenses.

This stick of fast-burning incense creates a haze of smoke that keeps plant creatures from closing on the user.

Alchemical Item: Common

Power ✦ Consumable (Standard Action)

Make an attack: Close burst 1; targets plants only; +10 vs. Fortitude; the burst creates a zone, and targets that are hit slide to the closest square outside the zone. The zone lasts until the end of the encounter, and plants that move into an affected square or begin their turn in an affected square are subject to the same attack from the greenbane.

Level 9: +15 vs. Fortitude.

Level 14: +20 vs. Fortitude.

Level 19: +25 vs. Fortitude.

Level 24: +30 vs. Fortitude.

Level 29: +35 vs. Fortitude.

Harvested from the bodies of ancient dead dragons, this poison is one of the most lethal.

Consumable: Assassin Poison - n

Power ✦ Consumable (Minor Action)

You apply the poison to a melee weapon or one piece of your ammunition. During this encounter, the next creature you hit with a weapon attack using the poisoned item falls prone, and it is stunned until the end of your next turn.

Power ✦ Consumable (Minor Action)

You apply the poison to a single handheld object. Within the next hour, the first creature other than you to hold or wear the object for more than 1 minute dies, but only if the creature is your level or lower.
